newsitem.title: UK: London's Trocadero agrees Pepsi sponsorship.
newsitem.headline: London's Trocadero agrees Pepsi sponsorship.

text.p: London's Trocadero entertainment and shopping complex said it has signed a sponsorship deal with Pepsi worth up to three million pounds.
It said it is to rename the Trocadero complex at Piccadilly "Pepsi Trocadero".
The Trocadero complex was relaunched earlier this month after a 50 million stg redevelopment expected to triple revenues over five years.
The Pepsi sponsorship deal will last two years.
